title: Total Error Sheets for Datasets (TES-D) A Critical Guide to Documenting Online Platform Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing a comprehensive documentation template (Total Error Sheets for Datasets - TES-D) that systematically evaluates dataset characteristics to expose platform affordance bias, platform coverage error, trace selection bias, user selection bias, and measurement errors in digital behavioral datasets.

Applying the proposed TES-D framework to a case study evaluating a Twitter sexism detection dataset ('Call me sexist, but...') to critically assess its construct validity, historical search constraints, trace selection criteria, and potential biases introduced by crowdworker annotations and automated toxicity classifiers.
